description: Copies a team workout or program into a new, editable item. Use when the user wants a copy to change, a variant, or a template to start from. Not for AI variants for a member (use create_similar_workout or create_similar_program). Returns the new item's ID and name.

id.description: ID of the workout or program to copy. Get it from list_team_workouts or list_team_programs.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

type.description: What to act on: workout = a single workout; program = a multi-week program.

name: duplicate_content
title: Duplicate workout or program
